title: Record one leading-quarter n=8 parity prefix at 25/16 (no new κ)
body:
## Summary

Records one nested triangular prefix for the n=8 symbol `(1, 1/4, 1/16, 1/16, 1/16, 1/16, 1/16, 1/16)`. The degree-1 sign left open by #4822 is inside the active 128-symbol claim, so this package records one different magnitude. No new κ. The selected record stays `60403/20000000`.

The tail `l1` is `5/8`. The largest proper prefix is `25/16`, strictly above `3/2`. The right shear alone is `1373/1024`, the next four proper prefixes are `11/8`, and the next five are `23/16`. Eleven proper prefixes equal `25/16`. The even-child left shear is the step that crosses `3/2`. The completed product matches the reordered Toeplitz matrix and has infinity norm `13/8`.

This package branches from main `624de9dc66858af0945e5f8a0942488d62280d43`. It does not replay an unmerged predecessor.

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/triangular-parity-leading-quarter
```
